warnings.title: IDD21013.cap
warnings.text: Maximum temperatures in the mid to high thirties and overnight minimum temperatures in the mid-twenties. Severe heatwave conditions are expected to develop over the Arnhem district and persist throughout the week. Severe heatwave conditions over the Tiwi Islands are expected to ease by mid-week.
